RADIO AND STREAMING ADVERTISING AGREEMENT

This Radio and Streaming Advertising Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into effective as of January 5, 2026 (the "Effective Date"), between ValleyWave Media Group, LLC, a California limited liability company ("Station"), and Meridian Mechanical Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation d/b/a Meridian Plumbing, Heating & Air, located at 2150 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 400, Sacramento, California 95833 ("Advertiser").

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Station operates radio broadcasting stations and streaming audio services in the Sacramento and Fresno, California markets; and

WHEREAS, Advertiser desires to purchase advertising time and services from Station for radio broadcast and streaming distribution during the 2026 heating and cooling seasons; and

WHEREAS, Station and Advertiser desire to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, Station and Advertiser agree as follows:

1. DEFINITIONS

"Advertiser Content" means the audio advertisements, copy, and creative materials provided by Advertiser or created by Station on behalf of Advertiser for broadcast.

"Effective Date" means January 5, 2026.

"Make-Good" means a complimentary broadcast spot or spots provided by Station to Advertiser as compensation for any failure to broadcast a scheduled advertisement.

"Term" means the period from the Effective Date through December 31, 2026.

2. SERVICES

Station agrees to provide advertising services consisting of broadcast of Advertiser's commercials on Station's radio stations and streaming audio platforms serving the Sacramento and Fresno markets during the Term. Station currently operates KZFM 101.9 FM (Sacramento), KFRS 98.5 FM (Fresno), and the associated streaming audio platform ValleyWave Digital, which provides online streaming access to all Station programming.

3. SCHEDULE

Advertising shall be broadcast according to the schedule set forth in the Schedule attached as Exhibit A and incorporated herein by reference. The schedule specifies the number of thirty-second spots, timing windows, and broadcast dates for the heating season (January 1, 2026 through March 31, 2026) and cooling season (May 15, 2026 through September 30, 2026). Station shall use reasonable efforts to broadcast all scheduled spots in the specified dayparts. Advertiser acknowledges that spot times are not guaranteed and that actual placement within the specified daypart windows is subject to broadcast operations and real-time scheduling adjustments. Station shall maintain a log of all broadcasts and shall provide weekly reports to Advertiser upon request.

4. CATEGORY EXCLUSIVITY

During the Term, Station agrees to provide Advertiser with category exclusivity in the plumbing, heating, air conditioning, and HVAC services category. Station shall not broadcast advertisements or sponsored content for any other plumbing contractor, HVAC contractor, or combined plumbing and HVAC service provider during any sponsored segment featuring Advertiser's content or within thirty minutes immediately preceding or following any Advertiser broadcast in the same daypart. This exclusivity applies to all Station properties, including KZFM, KFRS, and ValleyWave Digital. For purposes of this Agreement, "category exclusivity" shall not prevent Station from broadcasting public service announcements, news content, weather information, or traffic reports that may incidentally reference plumbing or HVAC services or emergency response services.

5. RATES AND PAYMENT

5.1 Advertising Rate. Station shall broadcast the advertising spots on the schedule and at the rates set forth in Exhibit A. The rate for a thirty-second spot during the 2026 heating season is Six Hundred Fifty Dollars ($650.00) per spot. The rate for a thirty-second spot during the 2026 cooling season is Seven Hundred Twenty-Five Dollars ($725.00) per spot. Total anticipated cost for the full schedule is Twenty-Eight Thousand Eight Hundred Seventy-Five Dollars ($28,875.00), calculated on a cost-per-spot basis according to the number of spots and rates specified in Exhibit A.

5.2 Payment Terms. Advertiser shall pay Station fifty percent (50%) of the total anticipated cost within fifteen (15) days of the Effective Date, and the remaining fifty percent (50%) within fifteen (15) days of May 15, 2026. All payments shall be made via wire transfer to the account designated by Station. Invoices shall be submitted by Station within five (5) business days of the Effective Date and at the start of the cooling season. Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one percent (1%) per month.

5.3 Advertiser Content. If Advertiser requires production services for creation of Advertiser Content, Station shall provide such services at no additional charge for up to two (2) thirty-second commercial spots. Additional production services shall be billed at the rate of One Hundred Seventy-Five Dollars ($175.00) per hour for on-air talent, production staff, and studio time.

6. MAKE-GOODS

In the event that Station fails to broadcast any scheduled spot due to Station error, technical failure, or failure to reserve the spot in the broadcast log, Station shall provide Advertiser with one (1) Make-Good spot of equal length and value, to be broadcast within thirty (30) days of the missed broadcast. If Station fails to provide the Make-Good within thirty (30) days, Station shall provide a credit to Advertiser's account in the amount of the missed spot. In no event shall Station's liability for missed broadcasts exceed the cost of the missed spots plus one Make-Good credit per missed spot. Advertiser must notify Station within five (5) business days of discovering a missed broadcast in order to claim a Make-Good.

7. ADVERTISER CONTENT AND REPRESENTATIONS

Advertiser represents and warrants that all Advertiser Content complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations, including Federal Communications Commission regulations and California consumer protection laws. Advertiser shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Station from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising from Advertiser Content, including but not limited to claims of defamation, false advertising, intellectual property infringement, or regulatory violations. Advertiser shall obtain all necessary licenses and permits for the services advertised. Station retains the right to refuse to broadcast any content that Station reasonably believes violates law or Station's broadcast standards.

8. CANCELLATION

Advertiser may cancel this Agreement upon fourteen (14) days' written notice to Station. In the event of cancellation by Advertiser, Advertiser shall be responsible for payment of all spots broadcast up to the effective date of cancellation. Advertiser shall not be obligated to pay for unbroadcast spots after the effective cancellation date. Station may cancel this Agreement if Advertiser materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within seven (7) days of receiving written notice from Station.

9. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Except with respect to indemnification obligations, breaches of confidentiality, or infringement of intellectual property rights, neither party's total liability under this Agreement shall exceed the total fees paid or payable by Advertiser for advertising services in the three (3) months preceding the claim. Neither party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages.

10. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflicts of law provisions. Any legal action or proceeding arising under this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Sacramento County, California, and both parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of such courts.

11. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement, together with Exhibit A, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, whether written or oral. Any modification of this Agreement must be in writing and signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
